topic: Analyzing problematic sensor data in India
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing anomalous sensor readings from facilities in India, specifically mentioning 'JCD-IN-DSHA05DM-Domestic SHA' and two curb-side locations. The core issue is that the sensors reported normal signal levels but then experienced sudden drops followed by equally sudden returns of data. Suggestions were made regarding the best format for presenting this information (file vs. task/ticket system). One participant noted potential traffic increases due to a major football championship event in the area.

Regarding the investigation, one participant offered to check the readings via RMC and write up findings for each location, though they initially stated they did not see any problems from their end.
decisions: The team will investigate the sudden data drops/returns on specific sensors.
action_items: Someone needs to review the sensor data anomalies (sudden drop/return of signal levels) at the specified Indian facilities.
Review findings via RMC and communicate them for each location.
